secrets.storage/authored/a-namespace-on-.purpose: A namespace mounted on the remote backend takes a put, a replace, a listing, a rename and a delete through the CLI.

secrets.storage/authored/bind-binds-a-na.purpose: Bind binds a name to a locator, binding it again is a conflict, a bound name cannot be renamed, and a missing namespace is not-found.

secrets.storage/authored/delete-removes-.purpose: Delete removes a secret, and deleting it again is not-found.

secrets.storage/authored/describe-shows-.purpose: Describe shows a secret's name, scope and version, the same row the listing holds, in any namespace.

secrets.storage/authored/list-reads-the-.purpose: List reads the names of a namespace's secrets, and each namespace's secrets stay in it.

secrets.storage/authored/mount-set-moves.purpose: Mount set moves an empty namespace to a configured backend, and refuses an unconfigured one and a namespace that holds secrets.

secrets.storage/authored/namespace-add-c.purpose: Namespace add creates a namespace on the default mount or the one named, and adding it again is a conflict.

secrets.storage/authored/namespace-list-.purpose: Namespace list holds namespace default and every added namespace, each with its mount.

secrets.storage/authored/namespace-remov.purpose: Namespace remove removes an empty namespace, and refuses namespace default and a namespace that holds a secret.

secrets.storage/authored/put-stores-a-se.purpose: Put stores a value under a name in tenant and user default, and a second put of the name replaces it.

secrets.storage/authored/rename-moves-a-.purpose: Rename moves a secret to a new name in its namespace, and the old name holds nothing afterwards.

secrets.storage/authored/unbind-removes-.purpose: Unbind removes a name's binding, unbinding it again is not-found, and the name can then be renamed.
